findings.trigger: CSV parser behavior with embedded CRLF
findings.impact: Potential data corruption during import if using standard Go `encoding/csv.Reader` which normalizes CRLF inside quoted fields, violating lossless requirement.
findings.evidence: Line 36-37: "Не використовувати `encoding/csv.Reader` як lossless parser: він нормалізує CRLF усередині поля." Line 29-30: "LF або CRLF поза лапками завершують record; усередині лапок LF/CRLF/CR зберігаються буквально."
findings.suggested_fix: Implement a custom CSV parser that strictly adheres to the quoted CRLF/LF/CR preservation rules specified. Include fixtures for quoted CRLF/LF/CR (line 101) in parser tests.

findings.impact: Data loss risk if different tuples produce the same hash and the system silently merges them, violating the identity preservation requirement (REQ-FR-02).
findings.evidence: Line 38: "UNIQUE (dataset_id,tuple_hash) з обов'язковою collision check до merge." Line 25-26: "Різні tuples з одним hash зупиняють імпорт/verify як collision." Line 61-62 in HLD.md: "hash collision має зупинити verify з явною помилкою, а не злити різні записи."
findings.suggested_fix: Enforce explicit collision detection during import/verify by comparing raw tuple fields when hashes match. Document this as a mandatory pre-publication check (AT-09).

findings.trigger: Cursor dataset pinning and retention policy gap
findings.impact: User-facing 410 errors if old datasets are garbage-collected before cursor expiration, breaking pagination for long-running queries.
findings.evidence: Line 58-59: "Dataset з token має бути раніше опублікований і retained; довільний staging ID не дає доступу до даних." Line 96-97 in IMPORT_CONTRACT.md: "GC/retention не виконується автоматично у V1." No explicit retention policy for cursor support duration.
findings.suggested_fix: Define a minimum retention period for published datasets (e.g., 30 days) to ensure cursor stability. Document this in the cursor contract and add a warning in the 410 response about dataset expiration.

findings.impact: Potential 400 errors for valid legacy URLs if alias resolution conflicts with explicit full codes (e.g., `en-gb` vs `en`).
findings.evidence: Line 48-51: "Fixed short aliases: `uk → uk-ua`, `en → en-us`; інші короткі коди → 400 до явного розширення таблиці. Якщо exact повний код існує, він має пріоритет; en-gb ніколи не зливається з en-us." Line 11-12 in LEGACY.md: "Missing il → ul (:318), missing ol → en-us."
findings.suggested_fix: Clarify alias resolution order: 1) exact full code match, 2) short alias expansion, 3) fallback. Document this in LEGACY_COMPATIBILITY.md and add fixtures for `en-gb` vs `en` (AT-12).

findings.impact: Data loss if an entire artifact is excluded without documenting the loss, violating REQ-FR-09 (accounting for all records).
findings.evidence: Line 80-81: "Виключення цілого artifact потребує нового manifest зі збереженим описом excluded source та звітом втрати." Line 41 in REQUIREMENTS.md: "Будь-яка втрата має reason, locator і явне рішення."
findings.suggested_fix: Require explicit operator confirmation for artifact-level exclusions and enforce a manifest update with a loss report. Add this to the import CLI workflow (e.g., `--exclude-artifact` flag with mandatory reason).

findings.impact: Inconsistent locale code mapping if the old `sr-sp → sr-rs` alias is applied without versioned control, risking silent data corruption.
findings.evidence: Line 28-29: "Старий alias `sr-sp → sr-rs` не застосовувати до всіх джерел без перевірки та версійного mapping." Line 19 in LEGACY.md: "має alias `sr-sp → sr-rs`."
findings.suggested_fix: Document alias handling as a versioned mapping rule in the manifest (e.g., `mapping_version: 1` with explicit alias table). Require operator review for legacy aliases during import (AT-11).

limitations: No implementation or test code was available for review; findings are based solely on documentation.
Deferred OQ-02/03/05/06 were acknowledged and not treated as automatic findings.
Legacy database schema and live data were not audited; findings assume documented constraints hold.
